create_llm_engine: create an LLM engine from an LLMEngineConfig using LLMEngineBuilder.create_engine
create_llama_api_engine: create a Llama API engine by setting LLAMA_API_KEY and using provider llama-api
create_local_engine: create a local LLM engine using provider local or mock with LiteLLM
create_hf_provider_engine: create a Hugging Face provider engine for providers like groq, openai, or cerebras
create_generic_litellm_engine: create a generic LiteLLM engine for any provider not explicitly listed
